program: MAT-01 — Cross-Surface Material / Shape Grammar Successor Divergence
bounded_question: Can an independently constructed grayscale material/shape grammar create a distinctive, restrained Kymaean-compatible cross-surface field language across APP-like and WEB-like carriers without relying on color identity, symbol/wordmark geometry, bespoke type, imagery, motion, product semantics, or historical hero composition?

authority.incumbent_reference: B — Mineral Theater, temporary V0 material authority only
authority.engineering_boundary: No native UI/WinUI visual authority; APP carriers are neutral research fixtures only.

neutral_fixture.content: identical abstract heading, supporting text, and three neutral content units across every family
neutral_fixture.rule: Fixture grayscale values expose structure only and carry no palette/brand authority.

CNEG.name: Conventional Card Stack
CNEG.topology: three equal rounded bordered cards over one flat field
CNEG.purpose: calibrate rejection of generic SaaS card composition

F1.name: Subtractive Channel
F1.topology: one continuous field interrupted by one or two edge-open negative channels; no nested cards

F2.name: Compression Relief
F2.topology: one continuous field with one shallow locally pressed region and restrained perimeter response

F3.name: Dry Joint Assemblage
F3.topology: two or three unequal non-grid masses held as one field by open dry joints and asymmetrical spacing

F4.name: Folded Continuum
F4.topology: one continuous plane with one restrained fold/crease orientation change; no detached cards
F4.identity_variable: continuous directional fold without arrow/book/paper metaphor

construction_law: CNEG is the only conventional-card control and cannot survive.
F1-F4 must be materially disjoint in topology; no family may be a parameter tweak of another.
Use only HTML/CSS primitives in the first packet; no images, SVG artwork, canvas, WebGL, remote resources, or generated media.
No family-specific hue. Grayscale level assignments may expose depth/edges but must use the same frozen level set.
APP may reduce relief/channel/fold amplitude versus WEB, but may not change family topology.
No family may encode selection, focus, loading, success, warning, causality, Character identity, Stage state, or navigation direction.
No family may quote Threshold K negative-space anatomy or O3 glyph construction.
Mineral Theater is compared only after independent family review; its exact colors/textures do not seed construction.
preflight_hard_checks: exact 5-family × 2-context × 2-viewport matrix in normal and forced-colors states
no horizontal document overflow at 1200 or 320 CSS px
all text remains >=4.5:1 in normal fixture
content remains readable and ordered when forced colors flatten decorative tones
no clipped required content or family-defining structural carrier at 320
APP and WEB preserve the same family topology
source contains no CLR-01 tokens, Threshold K/O3 assets, hero artwork, or product-state semantics
subjective_falsification: reads primarily as generic SaaS cards, glassmorphism, neumorphism, luxury-tech slab treatment, brutalist template, or another category convention
material carrier becomes more visually authoritative than content
APP and WEB cease to read as one grammar
family depends on hue, glow, texture spectacle, or imagery to become distinctive
family reads as an icon, control, progress/state indicator, directional arrow, book/page metaphor, puzzle, grid/tile system, terrain, architecture, installation, or hero-scene mechanism
family echoes Threshold K/O3 geometry strongly enough to act as a second mark
identity disappears at compact scale because the mechanism is only large-display ornament
family creates no material authorship beyond generic border/radius/shadow styling
review_order: 16/20/24/32-equivalent compact structural read inside APP carrier
direct comparison of any survivors against the historical Mineral Theater reference
freeze Design Sol view before any Director taste input if multiple materially valid survivors remain
explicit_non_authority: No final material system, palette, production token, component skin, app/site implementation, hero reopening, final identity, or Phase-C convergence.
